1933, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 96 Cont.
Mar. 8 Eliz. Connally - 18 - pneumonia Mrs. Doyle - 55 - cancer of stomach .. Helen Jankowski - 14 - T.B. Joseph Motsfields - 28 - Sore leg - has to support fam. Blank Page
Page 97 Page 98
Mar. 15 Jack Mc Carthy - 10 - sore back ??? Ed. Hart .... 19
Mrs. Rose Meyers - Fred Fisher's Mother-in-1
Ernest Hyland ... 42- operated this a.m. - two cancers ... Drs. give him a month or less. 8 yr. daughter offered her life that
Mrs. Tanner (n.c.) bronical asthma ...
Mrs. McFee middle aged bad nerves Adele Noonan - 32 - diabetis Pocket book lost on way hither - $62 ...
Salvatore Simonetta - 1651 Buena V. - lost mind & Faith - changed - now O.K.
Mar. 22 Mrs. Anna Cadaret - 51 - Cancer Roy Gaglis - 4 - speechless & cripple - sisters
Antoinet - 5 - speechless a few words
Loretta Ormond - 1 yr - intestinal flu - given up ten days ago, still battling for life.
Mrs. Eliz. Haf - 71 - to be operated on two weeks ago for cancer. We asked the prayers for her and enrolled her ... and Xray failed to show cancer ... now home but not very well
Irene Cehan - 19 - brain-tumor operation given up in January ... paralysed.
